notes: rk-nsex Tier A repair wave, LANDING-BLOCKER BL2, the EOF half. The quotable text ends exactly where the range ends, so nothing follows the statement to show that it ended — which is the shape a page-bounded or truncated extraction takes when the theorem continues onto a page that was never extracted. Pre-repair the check simply ran off the end of the line array and returned 'no problem', so every truncated-at-EOF extraction passed by construction. The rule is now fail-closed with an explicit, reviewable escape hatch: an EOF-terminated range is an ERROR unless the source's L0 record declares `ends_at_eof: {"<result_label>": true}` — an AUTHOR statement a reviewer can check, not an assumption the gate makes. `refs-27` is the positive control for that escape hatch (its L0 record declares `ends_at_eof` for `Lemma 4.2`, so its EOF-terminated range draws no envelope finding at all and only its intended `[stale-extraction]` fires); the declaration is also per-label, so an `ends_at_eof` naming a DIFFERENT result does not admit this one (test/gates/refs-records.test.ts). `aism_behavior: n/a`. Mutation-proof: treating an EOF-terminated range as unconditionally fine returns this tree to zero findings, exit 0; observed and reverted.
